_comment: Tier-2 Layer-C: kratos poisson numerical-correctness gate. Mirrors fenics + skfem + ngsolve poisson_mms_convergence. The Kratos catalog template (src/backends/kratos/generators/poisson.py) uses scipy-assembled P1 triangles on a Cartesian unit-square grid for the PDE itself — Kratos handles metadata + I/O only (task #25 tracks switching to the Kratos-native ConvectionDiffusion Application). This gate validates THE CURRENT catalog pattern converges optimally vs u = sin(π·x)·sin(π·y), f = 2π²·sin(π·x)·sin(π·y) on [0,1]². Asserts P1 nx=32 L2 error <= 3e-3, P1 EOC nx=16 → nx=32 in [1.7, 2.3]. Verified on 2026-06-01: P1 nx=32 L2 = 6.77e-4, EOC = 1.999 (essentially perfect — the element-centroid f sample happens to align with the manufactured solution at this resolution). MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 injects the defect this numeric gate exists to catch: the source term f is sampled at the triangle FIRST VERTEX instead of its centroid, an O(h) consistency error in the load. Measured: P1 h=1/32 L2 error goes 6.4e-04 -> 8.526e-03 (over the 3e-3 floor) and the observed EOC goes 2.0 -> 1.062, exactly the order loss that defect predicts. NOTE ON WHAT THIS FIXTURE ASSERTS: its expect_in_output entries "P1_h32_l2err=" and "P1_eoc_h16_to_h32=" are bare PREFIXES that match any value whatsoever, so the numeric gate rests ENTIRELY on the forbid string "FAIL:". The expect list certifies that the lines were printed, not that the numbers are right. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: no expect string disappears -- the fixture goes red on the forbidden FAIL: lines for both the error floor and the EOC window. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/poisson_mms_convergence && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
